senses.gloss:
—1 A ram.
—2 An elephant-driver or keeper.

मेठिः, मेढी, मेथिः
—1 A pillar, post.
—2 A pillar in the midst of a threshing-floor to which oxen are bound.
—3 A post to which cattle are bound; मेढ्यां गोचक्रवत्स्थास्नु परस्तात्
 कल्पवासिनाम् Bhāg. 4. 9. 21.
—4 A prop for supporting the shafts of a carriage.
